historical_review.text: Approved exact head 6f6599e6f591a5242b7cccf0cd5415fb34f20322, artifact 05663439 (.github/workflows/release.yml, blob d67de989 matches the tree). The head is one commit over v0.1.3 (e82a5b06) and changes only that file: the build, checksum-signing, archive-attestation and publish steps of the release job now read and write ${RUNNER_TEMP}/dist (attest via ${{ runner.temp }}), matching what the dry-run job already did; no step touches a dist path inside the checkout. Independent gates: GitHub CI run 33441142556 and Release run 33441142662 both completed with conclusion success at headSha 6f6599e. Reproduction: from a detached clean worktree at 6f6599e I ran scripts/release.sh v0.1.4 into a directory outside the checkout; the worktree stayed clean afterwards (git status --porcelain empty), all four archives plus install.sh, upgrade.sh, checksums.txt and SHA256SUMS were produced, and go version -m on the extracted darwin_arm64 binary reports vcs.revision=6f6599e6f591a5242b7cccf0cd5415fb34f20322 and vcs.modified=false, module version v0.1.4-0.20260831212218-6f6599e6f591 (local toolchain go1.27.0; the workflow pins 1.26.7, and the vcs stamping rule is the same). Architecture: release pipeline only; scripts/release.sh and scripts/build.sh are unchanged and still write only to the given output directory. Security: job permissions are unchanged (dry-run read-only; release job contents/attestations/id-token write); the immutable-tag and origin/main ancestry checks precede the build; stage directories are removed before gh release create globs the temp dist, so only archives, scripts, checksums, bundle and signature are published. Simplification: nothing to remove. Optional follow-up, not blocking: add a post-build test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" so a future in-checkout write fails the job before signing. Conditions of d4702a21 are met; builder may ratify, merge, tag v0.1.4 and verify the published archive's metadata.

v013_retirement.text: v0.1.3 is signed and installable but carries dirty build metadata; immutable successor v0.1.4 must build outside the checkout and verify dirty=false.

existing_controls: Both jobs now use RUNNER_TEMP. Release source verification checks checkout cleanliness before build. Existing release integration test builds fixture assets, verifies public dependency version/checksum/no replacement, and checks installed version; those controls must remain. This review identifies shared post-build proof of the actual workflow output as the opportunity.
limits: Read-only source/history review. No release rebuilt, no fresh signature verification, no reproduction of historical dirty output, no claim current assets are defective, no measured time-saving. Release API read independently showed v0.1.4 published with 10 expected named assets; that read does not prove all original publication conditions by itself.
